items.exampleEn: We stayed in an economical hotel near the station.
items.exampleZh: 我們住在車站附近一家經濟實惠的旅館。

items.exampleEn: We pay the phone bill by automatic debit each month.
items.exampleZh: 我們每個月用自動扣款繳電話費。

items.exampleEn: The city made a big investment in public parks.
items.exampleZh: 市政府在公共公園上做了一大筆投資。

items.exampleEn: Tourism brings in most of the island's revenue.
items.exampleZh: 觀光業帶來這座島大部分的收入。

items.exampleEn: I paid back the loan from my brother in six months.
items.exampleZh: 我在六個月內還清了跟我的兄弟借的錢。

items.exampleEn: Investors were excited about the new electric car.
items.exampleZh: 投資人對那款新電動車感到很興奮。

items.exampleEn: The old estate has a big house, a garden and a small lake.
items.exampleZh: 那座老莊園有一棟大房子、一座花園和一個小湖。

items.exampleEn: We received the first payment from the client yesterday.
items.exampleZh: 我們昨天收到了客戶的第一筆款項。

items.exampleEn: Turning off the lights led to a saving of ten percent on our bill.
items.exampleZh: 隨手關燈讓我們的帳單省了百分之十。

items.sentenceEn: This car is economical because it uses very little gas.
items.sentenceZh: 這輛車很省錢，因為它很省油。

items.audioEn: The bank approved my loan, so we can start building the new kitchen next month.
items.audioZh: 銀行核准了我的貸款，所以我們下個月就可以開始蓋新廚房。
items.questionZh: 說話者下個月可以開始做什麼？
options: Pay back the bank loan in full

items.sentenceEn: The museum's revenue from ticket sales rose last year.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館的門票收入去年增加了。

items.sentenceEn: Please make your payment before the end of the month.

items.stemEn: The company used a bank ____ to buy two new trucks.
items.stemZh: 那家公司用一筆銀行貸款買了兩輛新卡車。

items.stemEn: Buying rice in large bags is more ____ than buying small packets.
items.stemZh: 買大袋的米比買小包裝的更划算。

items.passageEn: Mr. and Mrs. Lu own a large tea estate in the mountains. Ten years ago, they decided to turn part of it into a small hotel. They used their savings and took out a loan from a local bank. Two investors from Taipei also joined the venture, each making an investment of five million dollars. At first, revenue was low, and the couple worried about the monthly payments to the bank. To keep costs down, they chose economical solar lights and hired local workers. Today, the hotel is full almost every weekend. Guests can pay in cash or by credit or debit card.
items.passageZh: 呂先生和呂太太在山上擁有一大片茶園。十年前，他們決定把其中一部分改成一間小旅館。他們用了自己的存款，也向地方銀行申請了貸款。兩位台北的投資人也加入了這項事業，各投資五百萬元。一開始營收很低，夫妻倆很擔心每個月要付給銀行的款項。為了壓低成本，他們選用省錢的太陽能燈，並僱用當地的員工。如今，旅館幾乎每個週末都客滿。客人可以用現金、信用卡或金融卡付款。

questions.questionZh: 一開始呂先生夫婦為什麼很擔心？
options: 收入低，每月還要付銀行錢
附近又開了一家更大更新的飯店
兩位投資人想要拿回他們投資的錢

items.promptZh: 買新電腦對我們公司來說是一筆很好的投資。
referenceEn: Buying new computers was a good investment for our company.
The new computers were a great investment for our company.
rubricZh: 主詞可用動名詞或名詞（例如 Buying new computers、The new computers 等）
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）

items.promptZh: 這家小吃店只接受現金付款。
referenceEn: This snack shop only accepts cash payments.
This small food shop accepts payment in cash only.
rubricZh: 「現金付款」可寫，例如 cash payments、payment in cash 等
「只」可寫，例如 only accepts、in cash only 等，only 位置不扣分
「小吃店」可寫，例如 snack shop、small food shop、food stand 等
